openers.prompt_en: A cricket coach says a new bat gives higher scores. Players use it for five matches and record their runs; they also record runs from five matches with their old bat. Which can help test the coach’s idea: the coach’s reputation or the recorded runs?
openers.prompt_hi: Cricket coach kehte hain ki naya bat zyada runs dilata hai. Players naye bat se paanch matches ke runs aur purane bat se paanch matches ke runs record karte hain. Coach ki baat test karne mein kya madad karega: unki reputation ya record kiye gaye runs?
hints: Which choice could you compare with actual match results?
An idea needs observations or measurements, not just a trusted speaker.
To check the claim, compare the two sets of ___.
The recorded runs: they provide results that can test the claim.

openers.prompt_en: A student thinks heavier objects always fall faster. In a classroom test, two balls of different masses are dropped together from the same height and land together. Should the student keep or change the idea?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek student sochta hai ki bhaari cheezein hamesha jaldi girti hain. Class test mein alag mass ki do balls ek hi height se saath chhodi jaati hain aur saath land karti hain. Student ko apna idea rakhna chahiye ya badalna chahiye?
hints: Did the result match what the student expected?
A scientific idea must be reconsidered when observations disagree with it.
The result disagrees with ‘always’, so the student should ___.
Change the idea: the test contradicts the claim that this always happens.

harder.prompt_en: A phone ad says its battery lasts 20 hours. Meera times the same model on three full charges and gets about 13 hours each time. Why should she question the ad’s claim?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek phone ad kehta hai ki uski battery 20 ghante chalti hai. Meera same model ko teen full charges par time karti hai aur har baar lagbhag 13 ghante milte hain. Use ad ke claim par sawaal kyun uthana chahiye?
harder.answer: Repeated measurements do not support the ad’s claim
acceptable: her measurements disagree with the claim
repeated observations show a shorter battery life
baar-baar ki measurement claim ko support nahi karti
hints: What did Meera check herself, rather than simply read?
Compare a claim with measured results, especially when a result repeats.
Her repeated measurements ___ the claim.
Repeated measurements do not support the claim: they show a shorter duration.

verified.solverAnswer: Her repeated evidence contradicts the claim.
verified.note: Equivalent meaning on repeated measurements vs claim

harder.prompt_en: During different lunar eclipses, observers see Earth’s shadow on the Moon as curved. Why did this evidence make the idea of a flat Earth less convincing?
harder.prompt_hi: Alag-alag lunar eclipses mein observers ko Moon par Earth ki shadow curved dikhti hai. Is evidence se flat Earth ka idea kam convincing kyun hua?
harder.answer: A curved shadow supports a round Earth rather than a flat one
acceptable: the curved shadow is evidence that Earth is round
shadow ka curve Earth ke gol hone ko support karta hai
hints: What shape does the shadow’s edge suggest?
Use the observed shadow to compare the two ideas about Earth.
The shadow fits the idea of a ___ Earth better.
A curved shadow supports a round Earth, making the flat-Earth idea less convincing.

verified.solverAnswer: Only a sphere always casts a curved shadow.
verified.note: Solver incomplete on flat Earth disproof

harder.prompt_en: A school wants to test whether adding salt makes ice melt faster. Choose the fair plan: A) Change salt amount and ice-cube size together; B) Use equal ice cubes at the same temperature, change only salt amount, and repeat; C) Compare one cube today with another tomorrow.
harder.prompt_hi: School test karna chahta hai ki salt daalne se ice jaldi melt hoti hai ya nahi. Fair plan chuno: A) Salt aur ice-cube size dono badlo; B) Equal ice cubes same temperature par rakho, sirf salt amount badlo aur test repeat karo; C) Ek cube aaj aur doosra kal compare karo.
harder.answer: B
hints: Which plan lets you tell what caused any difference?
Keep other conditions alike; vary the factor being tested and repeat.
The fair plan changes only ___ while keeping other conditions alike.
B: it varies salt alone, keeps conditions alike, and repeats the test.

openers.prompt_en: A Pune school records how quickly different compost mixtures help seeds sprout. A school in Jaipur wants to compare its results. Besides the results, should Pune share its method or only photos of the sprouts?
openers.prompt_hi: Pune ka school record karta hai ki alag compost mein beej kitni jaldi ugte hain. Jaipur ka school apne results compare karna chahta hai. Pune ko results ke saath method share karna chahiye ya sirf sprouts ki photos?
hints: What would Jaipur need to make a fair comparison?
Think about keeping the steps the same.
Pune should share its results and its ___.
Share its method, so Jaipur can repeat the test.

openers.prompt_en: A Chennai team measures air pollution near a busy road. A Delhi team uses the Chennai team's published measuring steps but tests a different road. Are they building on earlier work or starting without it?
openers.prompt_hi: Chennai ki team busy road ke paas air pollution naapti hai. Delhi ki team unke published measuring steps se doosri road test karti hai. Kya Delhi team pehle ke kaam par aage badh rahi hai ya uske bina shuru kar rahi hai?
acceptable: pehle ke kaam par aage badh rahi hai
hints: Where did the Delhi team get its measuring steps?
Using another team's steps connects the two investigations.
The Delhi team is ___ earlier work.
Building on earlier work: it uses the Chennai team's published steps.

harder.prompt_en: Two labs report different results for how long a phone battery lasts. Both publish their methods. Why should they compare their methods before deciding which result is correct?
harder.prompt_hi: Do labs phone battery kitni der chalti hai, is par alag results dete hain. Dono apne methods publish karte hain. Sahi result tay karne se pehle unhe methods compare kyun karne chahiye?
harder.answer: Different testing conditions may explain the different results
acceptable: test karne ki conditions alag ho sakti hain
hints: Could both labs have tested under identical conditions?
A result depends partly on how it was measured.
Different ___ may explain the results.
Different testing conditions may explain why the results differ.

verified.solverAnswer: Differences in method may cause the different results.
verified.note: Both convey methods explain result differences

harder.prompt_en: A science club pairs scientists with work: Janaki Ammal—plant studies; Ibn al-Haytham—studies of light; Aryabhata—sensitive instruments for plant responses. Which pairing should they correct?
harder.prompt_hi: Science club ne pairs banaye: Janaki Ammal—paudhon ka adhyayan; Ibn al-Haytham—roshni ka adhyayan; Aryabhata—paudhon ki responses naapne ke sensitive instruments. Kaunsa pair sudharna chahiye?
harder.answer: Aryabhata—sensitive instruments for plant responses
hints: Which named scientist is associated with mathematics and astronomy?
Plant-response instruments belong to another Indian scientist.
The incorrect pairing begins with ___.
Correct Aryabhata’s pairing; J.C. Bose made sensitive plant-response instruments.

harder.prompt_en: During a heatwave, students in Surat record the temperature at the same shaded spot every afternoon and share their table with a local research group. Is this scientific evidence or just an opinion? Give one reason.
harder.prompt_hi: Heatwave mein Surat ke students roz dopahar ek hi chhaya wali jagah ka temperature record karke table local research group ko bhejte hain. Yeh scientific evidence hai ya sirf opinion? Ek wajah batao.
harder.answer: Scientific evidence, because they made systematic measurements
acceptable: evidence because they recorded measurements consistently
scientific evidence, kyunki unhone niyamit naap liya
hints: Are the students guessing, or recording observations?
Repeated measurements can be checked by others.
It is ___ because the students measured consistently.
Scientific evidence: they made systematic measurements, not just a guess.

verified.solverAnswer: Scientific evidence; it is systematically collected and shared data.
verified.note: Both affirm systematic measurements as evidence

openers.prompt_en: A labelled antacid liquid is described as bitter and soapy. Without tasting or touching it, would you expect it to be acidic or basic?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek labelled antacid liquid ko bitter aur soapy bataya gaya hai. Bina taste ya touch kiye, tum ise acidic kahoge ya basic?
hints: Which clue matters more here: bitter and soapy, or sour?
Match the description to the properties of acids and bases.
Bitter and soapy are properties usually linked with ___.
Basic: bases are often described as bitter and soapy.

openers.prompt_en: A lab report says a sports drink is acidic. What colour will blue litmus paper turn when dipped in it?
openers.prompt_hi: Lab report kehta hai ki ek sports drink acidic hai. Ismein dip karne par blue litmus paper kis rang ka hoga?
hints: Which litmus rule applies to an acidic liquid?
Think about what acids do to blue litmus.
In an acid, blue litmus turns ___.
Red: acids turn blue litmus red.

harder.prompt_en: At a school science fair, a clear solution changes neither red nor blue litmus. Classify it as acidic, basic or neutral.
harder.prompt_hi: School science fair mein ek clear solution na red litmus badalta hai, na blue litmus. Ise acidic, basic ya neutral classify karo.
harder.answer: Neutral
hints: What does it mean when both litmus papers stay unchanged?
Compare the observation with the litmus rules for acids and bases.
Neither litmus changes, so the solution is ___.
Neutral: it changes neither red nor blue litmus.

harder.prompt_en: A cleaner turns yellow turmeric paper reddish-brown and red hibiscus extract green. Classify the cleaner as acidic, basic or neutral.
harder.prompt_hi: Ek cleaner yellow turmeric paper ko reddish-brown aur red hibiscus extract ko green kar deta hai. Cleaner acidic, basic ya neutral hai?
harder.answer: Basic
hints: Do both indicator results point to the same category?
Recall what makes turmeric paper change from yellow.
These two colour changes indicate the cleaner is ___.
Basic: bases change turmeric to reddish-brown and hibiscus extract to green.

harder.prompt_en: A student wants to taste an unlabelled liquid to decide if it is an acid or base. Why should they use an indicator instead?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek student unlabelled liquid ko taste karke acid ya base pehchanna chahta hai. Use indicator kyun istemal karna chahiye?
harder.answer: Unknown acids and bases may be dangerous; indicators test them without tasting.
acceptable: It could be a harmful acid or base
Strong acids and strong bases can harm you
Taste karna dangerous ho sakta hai; indicator safer hai
hints: What risk comes with putting an unknown liquid in your mouth?
Some acids and bases can harm the body.
An indicator helps identify it without ___.
Indicators avoid tasting; strong acids and bases can both cause harm.

verified.solverAnswer: Tasting can be dangerous; indicators are safe and reliable.
verified.note: Both stress safety of indicator over tasting

openers.prompt_en: In a school lab, Meera carefully adds a base to vinegar. The mixture becomes slightly warm. Which reaction explains this: neutralisation or evaporation?
openers.prompt_hi: School lab mein Meera vinegar mein dhyan se ek base milati hai. Mixture thoda garam ho jata hai. Iski wajah kaunsi reaction hai: neutralisation ya evaporation?
hints: Which two kinds of substances were mixed?
Think about what can happen when an acid reacts with a base.
Acid + base reacting and releasing heat points to ___.
Neutralisation: an acid and a base react, giving out heat.

openers.prompt_en: A science club adds an alkaline solution to an acidic sample until universal indicator turns green. Was the acid neutralised or only diluted?
openers.prompt_hi: Science club ek acidic sample mein alkaline solution milata hai, jab tak universal indicator green nahi ho jata. Acid neutralise hua ya sirf dilute hua?
hints: What was added to the acidic sample?
The indicator colour tells you the mixture’s final nature.
An acid reacting with an alkaline solution can become ___.
Neutralised: the added alkali reacts with the acid; green indicates neutral.

harder.prompt_en: During a lab demonstration, an acid and a base are mixed in the right amounts. The beaker warms up. Why can the teacher say this is a chemical reaction, not just mixing?
harder.prompt_hi: Lab demonstration mein acid aur base sahi matra mein milaye jate hain. Beaker garam ho jata hai. Teacher ise sirf mixing ke bajay chemical reaction kyun kehti hain?
harder.answer: New substances, salt and water, form and heat is released.
acceptable: Salt and water form, and heat is given out
Naye padarth bante hain aur heat nikalti hai
hints: Besides warming, what changes when the substances react?
A chemical reaction produces substances different from those added.
Acid + base produces ___ and releases heat.
Salt and water form, and heat is released; new substances show a reaction.

verified.solverAnswer: Heat is produced, showing a new substance is formed.
verified.note: Solver misses salt+water formation

harder.prompt_en: Two acidic samples start at the same strength. Riya adds water to A; Arjun adds a base to B. Both colours become less strongly acidic on universal indicator. Which sample could become neutral through a reaction: A or B?
harder.prompt_hi: Do acidic samples shuru mein ek jaise hain. Riya A mein paani milati hai; Arjun B mein base milata hai. Universal indicator par dono kam acidic dikhte hain. Reaction se kaunsa sample neutral ho sakta hai: A ya B?
harder.answer: B
hints: Which addition can react with an acid?
Water spreads an acid out; a base can cancel its effect.
The sample receiving a base is ___.
B: its added base can react with and neutralise the acid.

harder.prompt_en: A factory tests its wastewater before release. The water is basic. Should workers add a suitable acid or a suitable base to treat it by neutralisation?
harder.prompt_hi: Factory release se pehle apne wastewater ko test karti hai. Paani basic hai. Neutralisation se treat karne ke liye workers suitable acid milayen ya suitable base?
harder.answer: A suitable acid
hints: What is the wastewater’s nature now?
Neutralisation needs a substance with the opposite nature.
To react with a basic solution, add a suitable ___.
A suitable acid: it reacts with the base in the wastewater.

openers.prompt_en: While checking a torch bulb for the school camp, Meera sees a very thin wire inside its glass. What is that part called?
openers.prompt_hi: School camp ke liye torch bulb check karte waqt Meera ko glass ke andar ek bahut patla taar dikhta hai. Is part ko kya kehte hain?
hints: Which part inside a bulb produces light when current passes through it?
Name the thin wire, not the bulb’s outer glass.
The thin wire inside the bulb is its ___.
Filament: it is the thin wire inside the bulb that glows.

openers.prompt_en: For a science display, a bulb’s bottom tip touches one cell terminal. Which second connection can make it glow: its metal side to the other cell terminal, or its glass to that terminal?
openers.prompt_hi: Science display mein bulb ki neeche wali tip cell ke ek terminal ko chhoo rahi hai. Bulb jalane ke liye doosra connection kaunsa hoga: uski metal side doosre terminal se, ya uska glass us terminal se?
openers.answer: Its metal side to the other cell terminal
acceptable: metal side to the other terminal
hints: Which bulb surface can carry current?
Both bulb terminals must become part of the path.
Connect the bulb’s ___ to the cell’s unused terminal.
Metal side to the other terminal: this completes the conducting path.

verified.solverAnswer: its metal side to the other cell terminal

harder.prompt_en: In a model metro signal, both bulb terminals are connected to the cell, but a switch leaves a gap in one wire. If a student closes the switch, will the bulb glow or stay off?
harder.prompt_hi: Model metro signal mein bulb ke dono terminals cell se connected hain, lekin switch ek taar mein gap chhodta hai. Student switch band kare toh bulb jalega ya band rahega?
harder.answer: Glow
hints: What happens to the gap when the switch closes?
Trace the path through the cell, wires, switch and bulb.
Closing the switch makes the path ___, so the bulb will ___.
Glow: closing the switch completes the path through the bulb.

harder.prompt_en: A circuit has two bulbs in one complete loop. Kabir says the first bulb uses up the current, leaving none for the second. Why can the second bulb still glow?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek complete loop mein do bulbs lage hain. Kabir kehta hai pehla bulb saara current use kar leta hai, isliye doosre ke liye kuch nahi bachta. Phir doosra bulb kyun jal sakta hai?
harder.answer: Current flows around the complete loop; the first bulb does not use it up.
acceptable: current is not used up by the first bulb
current flows through both bulbs in the closed loop
pehla bulb current khatam nahi karta
hints: Does current stop at the first bulb?
Think of current moving around one complete path.
Current continues through the ___ because the path is ___.
Current flows through both: a bulb does not use up current.

verified.solverAnswer: Current is not used up; same current flows through both.
verified.note: Both state current not used up in loop

harder.prompt_en: For a school-project lamp, Asha joins two cells and needs a safe power source. Which plan is correct: positive-to-negative with cells only, positive-to-positive with cells only, or positive-to-negative using a wall socket?
harder.prompt_hi: School-project lamp ke liye Asha do cells jod rahi hai aur safe power source chahiye. Kaunsa plan sahi hai: positive-to-negative aur sirf cells, positive-to-positive aur sirf cells, ya positive-to-negative aur wall socket?
harder.answer: Positive-to-negative with cells only
acceptable: positive to negative with cells only
hints: How are neighbouring cells joined in a battery?
Then consider which power source is safe for classroom experiments.
Join one cell’s ___ to the next cell’s ___; use ___.
Positive-to-negative with cells only: sockets can be dangerous.

openers.prompt_en: A student draws a circuit diagram for a bicycle light. Which symbol should represent its bulb: a circle with a cross inside, or two parallel lines of unequal length?
openers.prompt_hi: Bicycle light ka circuit diagram banate waqt bulb ke liye kaunsa symbol use karoge: andar cross wala circle, ya alag lambai ki do parallel lines?
openers.answer: A circle with a cross inside
hints: Which option represents the part that lights up?
The other option represents a source of electrical energy.
For the bulb, choose the symbol with a ___ inside.
A circle with a cross represents a bulb in a circuit diagram.

verified.solverAnswer: a circle with a cross inside

openers.prompt_en: In a school-project circuit, wires join a cell, switch and buzzer in one loop. The diagram shows a gap at the switch. Will the buzzer sound: yes or no?
openers.prompt_hi: School project mein wires se cell, switch aur buzzer ek loop mein jude hain. Diagram mein switch par gap dikh raha hai. Kya buzzer bajega: haan ya nahin?
hints: Can current travel all the way around this loop?
Check what the switch symbol says about the path.
At the gap, the path is ___, so the buzzer ___ sound.
No; the gap breaks the path needed for current to flow.

harder.prompt_en: A model traffic signal has one battery, a switch and one lamp, joined in a single loop. In its circuit diagram, which order along the loop matches it: battery–switch–lamp–battery, or battery–lamp–battery with the switch on a separate branch?
harder.prompt_hi: Model traffic signal mein ek battery, switch aur lamp ek hi loop mein jude hain. Diagram mein kaunsa order sahi hai: battery–switch–lamp–battery, ya battery–lamp–battery aur switch alag branch par?
harder.answer: Battery–switch–lamp–battery
hints: How many paths does the real circuit have?
Keep every component on the same path in the diagram.
Trace the loop: battery → ___ → lamp → battery.
Battery–switch–lamp–battery matches the single loop.

harder.prompt_en: A torch stops shining when its switch is opened, though its cells remain fitted. Why does closing the switch make the bulb shine without supplying electricity itself?
harder.prompt_hi: Torch ka switch kholne par roshni band ho jaati hai, lekin cells lage rehte hain. Switch band karne se bulb kyun jalta hai, jabki switch khud electricity supply nahin karta?
harder.answer: Closing the switch completes the path for current from the cells.
acceptable: it completes the circuit so current flows from the cells
switch raasta poora karta hai; current cells se aata hai
hints: What remains in the torch when the switch is open?
Think about the path current needs around the circuit.
Closing the switch completes the ___; energy comes from the ___.
The switch completes the path; the cells supply electrical energy.

verified.solverAnswer: Switch completes the circuit path; electricity then flows.
verified.note: Both explain switch completes circuit

harder.prompt_en: Two identical bulbs are tested separately. Circuit A has one cell; circuit B has two identical cells connected correctly in a battery. Both switches are closed. Which bulb is likely brighter: A or B?
harder.prompt_hi: Do ek jaise bulbs alag-alag test kiye gaye. Circuit A mein ek cell hai; circuit B mein do ek jaise cells sahi tarah battery mein jude hain. Dono switches band hain. Kaunsa bulb zyada bright hoga: A ya B?
harder.answer: B
hints: What differs between these otherwise similar circuits?
Compare what one cell and two correctly connected cells provide.
The circuit with ___ cells is likely brighter.
B; its two correctly connected cells can make the bulb brighter.

openers.prompt_en: A tester has a cell, bulb and a gap between two wire ends. Meera puts a metal zip pull across the gap, and the bulb glows. Is the zip pull a conductor or an insulator?
openers.prompt_hi: Cell, bulb aur do wire ends ke beech gap wale tester mein Meera metal zip pull lagati hai. Bulb jalta hai. Zip pull conductor hai ya insulator?
hints: What does the glowing bulb tell you about the circuit?
The material in the gap lets current pass or blocks it.
If current passes through the zip pull, classify it as ___.
Conductor: the glowing bulb shows current passes through it.

openers.prompt_en: A pencil's graphite core is placed across the gap in a cell-and-bulb tester. Would you predict that the bulb glows or stays off?
openers.prompt_hi: Pencil ki graphite core ko cell-aur-bulb tester ke gap mein lagaya gaya. Tumhare hisaab se bulb jalega ya band rahega?
hints: Is every non-metal an insulator?
Think about the special electrical property of graphite.
If current passes through the core, the bulb ___.
Glows: graphite is a non-metal that conducts electricity.

harder.prompt_en: In a cell-and-bulb tester, an aluminium snack wrapper makes the bulb glow. The same wrapper, folded so only its plastic-coated side touches both wire ends, does not. Which layer conducts: aluminium or plastic coating?
harder.prompt_hi: Cell-aur-bulb tester mein aluminium snack wrapper se bulb jalta hai. Wrapper fold karne par sirf plastic-coated side dono wire ends ko chhooti hai, aur bulb nahi jalta. Kaunsi layer conduct karti hai: aluminium ya plastic coating?
harder.answer: Aluminium
hints: Which contact allowed the bulb to glow?
Compare the layer touching the wires in each test.
The conducting layer is ___.
Aluminium: the bulb glows when that layer completes the circuit.

harder.prompt_en: A school repairs an electric bell using copper wire covered in plastic. Why is the copper inside but the plastic outside?
harder.prompt_hi: School ki electric bell repair karne ke liye plastic se covered copper wire use hota hai. Copper andar aur plastic bahar kyun hota hai?
harder.answer: Copper conducts current to the bell; plastic insulates the wire to help prevent shocks.
acceptable: copper carries current while plastic prevents contact and shocks
hints: Which part needs to carry current to the bell?
The covering should stop current reaching someone who touches it.
Copper ___ current; plastic ___ the wire.
Copper conducts to the bell; plastic insulates to help prevent shocks.

verified.solverAnswer: Copper conducts electricity, plastic insulates and prevents shocks.
verified.note: Both explain copper conducts, plastic insulates

harder.prompt_en: After washing up, Arjun's hands are wet with tap water. Why should he dry them before touching the switch of his phone charger?
harder.prompt_hi: Haath dhone ke baad Arjun ke haath tap water se geele hain. Phone charger ka switch chhoone se pehle use haath kyun sukhane chahiye?
harder.answer: Tap water and the human body can conduct electricity, so wet hands increase the risk of electric shock.
acceptable: wet hands can conduct electricity and cause a shock
water can help current pass through the body
hints: How might wet hands change the risk at a switch?
Tap water and the body can provide a path for current.
Dry hands reduce the risk of an electric ___.
Wet hands raise shock risk because tap water and the body can conduct.

verified.solverAnswer: Tap water may contain impurities, making it a conductor, risking electric shock.
verified.note: Both explain conductivity and shock risk.

openers.prompt_en: A steel thali makes a clear ringing sound when tapped, but a plastic plate does not. Which property of metals explains the thali’s sound?
openers.prompt_hi: Steel ki thali ko tap karne par saaf bajne ki awaaz aati hai, par plastic plate se nahi. Metals ki kaunsi property is awaaz ko samjhati hai?
hints: What difference do you hear when the two plates are tapped?
Think of the name for a material’s ability to ring.
A metal’s ringing quality is called ___.
Sonority: metals produce a ringing sound when struck.

openers.prompt_en: A dry piece of charcoal snaps rather than flattening when pressed. Which property does this show: brittleness or ductility?
openers.prompt_hi: Sookhe charcoal ka tukda dabane par chapta hone ke bajay toot jaata hai. Yeh kaunsi property dikhata hai: brittleness ya ductility?
hints: Does the charcoal change shape or break?
Choose the property that describes breaking under pressure.
Breaking instead of changing shape shows ___.
Brittleness: the charcoal breaks rather than flattening.

harder.prompt_en: For a school display, Meera must bend a strip into a new shape without snapping it. She has a copper strip and a sulphur strip. Which should she choose, and why?
harder.prompt_hi: School display ke liye Meera ko ek strip bina tode naye shape mein modni hai. Uske paas copper aur sulphur ki strips hain. Woh kaunsi chune, aur kyun?
harder.answer: Copper; it can be bent without breaking, whereas sulphur is brittle.
acceptable: copper; it bends while sulphur breaks
tamba; sulphur aasani se toot ta hai
hints: What might happen if Meera bends each strip?
Compare how a metal and a brittle non-metal respond to bending.
Choose ___ because it bends; the other strip may snap.
Copper bends without breaking; brittle sulphur may snap.

verified.solverAnswer: Copper strip, because it is ductile and can bend without breaking.
verified.note: Both identify copper's ductility vs sulphur brittleness.

harder.prompt_en: A student puts graphite from a pencil into a simple battery-and-bulb circuit. Will the bulb glow or stay off? Name the property that explains your prediction.
harder.prompt_hi: Ek student pencil ke graphite ko simple battery-bulb circuit mein lagata hai. Bulb jalega ya band rahega? Apni prediction samjhane wali property batao.
harder.answer: The bulb will glow; graphite conducts electricity.
acceptable: glow; graphite is an electrical conductor
jalega; graphite bijli conduct karta hai
hints: What must pass through graphite for the bulb to work?
Some non-metals are exceptions to the usual electrical pattern.
The bulb will ___ if graphite lets current pass.
The bulb glows because graphite conducts electricity.

verified.note: Both state glow due to conductivity.

harder.prompt_en: A steel saucepan has a steel base but a plastic handle. Why is plastic useful for the handle when the pan is heated?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek steel saucepan ka base steel ka hai, lekin handle plastic ka hai. Pan garam hone par handle ke liye plastic kyun useful hai?
harder.answer: Plastic is a poor conductor of heat, so the handle heats up less.
acceptable: plastic does not conduct heat well
plastic se heat kam guzarti hai, isliye handle kam garam hota hai
hints: What would make a handle uncomfortable to hold?
Compare how easily heat travels through steel and plastic.
Plastic lets ___ heat reach the hand.
Plastic conducts heat poorly, so the handle heats up less.

verified.solverAnswer: Plastic is a poor conductor of heat, preventing burns.
verified.note: Both cite poor heat conduction of plastic.

openers.prompt_en: A damp iron cricket stump develops a reddish-brown, flaky layer. Is this layer a new substance or just mud stuck to the stump?
openers.prompt_hi: Nami mein rakhe lohe ke cricket stump par laal-bhoori, papridaar parat ban gayi. Kya yeh naya padarth hai ya stump par chipki hui mitti?
hints: Would ordinary mud need the iron to change?
Think about what happens when iron reacts with its surroundings.
The flaky layer forms because the iron has ___ .
It is a new substance: the iron has reacted and formed rust.

verified.solverAnswer: A new substance (rust, which is iron oxide).

openers.prompt_en: Two identical iron clips sit in open jars. One jar is dry; the other contains water that touches its clip. Which clip is more likely to rust: the dry-jar clip or the water-jar clip?
openers.prompt_hi: Do ek jaise iron clips khule jars mein hain. Ek jar sookha hai; doosre mein paani clip ko chhoo raha hai. Kis clip par jung lagne ki sambhavna zyada hai: sookhe jar wali ya paani wale jar wali?
hints: What is different between the two jars?
Both jars are open, but only one clip gets moisture.
The clip with air and ___ is more likely to rust.
The water-jar clip: it has both air and water.

harder.prompt_en: Three iron pins are left for a week: A in dry air, B under boiled water covered with oil, C in ordinary water in an open cup. Which pin should rust most: A, B or C?
harder.prompt_hi: Teen iron pins ek hafte ke liye rakhi hain: A sookhi hawa mein, B ubale paani ke andar tel ki parat ke neeche, C khule cup ke aam paani mein. Sabse zyada jung kis par lagegi: A, B ya C?
harder.answer: C
acceptable: ordinary water in an open cup
hints: Which setup gives the pin access to both needed conditions?
Dry air lacks moisture; boiled water under oil limits oxygen.
The setup with moisture and access to air is ___ .
C: its pin has water and access to oxygen in air.

harder.prompt_en: A school’s iron cycle stand has many scratches, and staff want long-lasting rust protection without repeatedly painting it. Which is better: galvanising it with zinc or washing it daily with water?
harder.prompt_hi: School ke iron cycle stand par kai scratches hain. Staff baar-baar paint kiye bina lambe samay tak jung se bachana chahte hain. Kya behtar hai: zinc se galvanise karna ya roz paani se dhona?
harder.answer: Galvanising it with zinc
hints: Which option puts a protective layer on the iron?
Daily washing can leave moisture on scratches.
A protective coating of ___ keeps iron from direct contact.
Galvanising with zinc: its coating protects the iron from rusting.

harder.prompt_en: A copper trophy, silver medal and gold medal are displayed in a humid school corridor. After years, which one is most likely to develop a green coating: copper, silver or gold?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek copper trophy, silver medal aur gold medal school ke nami wale corridor mein rakhe hain. Kuch saalon baad kis par hari parat banne ki sambhavna sabse zyada hai: copper, silver ya gold?
harder.answer: Copper
hints: Do these three metals change colour in the same way?
Recall which metal develops a green surface over time.
The metal linked with a green coating is ___ .
Copper: its surface can turn green in moist air.

openers.prompt_en: At room temperature, a lab has iodine crystals in a sealed jar. Is this non-metal a solid, liquid or gas?
openers.prompt_hi: Room temperature par lab mein iodine crystals sealed jar mein hain. Yeh non-metal solid, liquid ya gas hai?
hints: What does the word ‘crystals’ tell you about its form?
Classify iodine by its state at room temperature.
At room temperature, iodine crystals are a ___.
Solid: iodine crystals keep their shape at room temperature.

openers.prompt_en: A class discusses the non-metals in food that help build our bodies. Which is one of them: carbon or helium?
openers.prompt_hi: Class mein food ke un non-metals ki baat ho rahi hai jo hamari body banane mein madad karte hain. Carbon ya helium—kaunsa ek hai?
hints: Which option is found in the substances that make up food?
Think about what living bodies are built from.
The non-metal in food that helps build the body is ___.
Carbon: it forms part of food and living bodies.

harder.prompt_en: A lab stores sulphur powder and chlorine in separate sealed containers at room temperature. Which one is a gas: sulphur or chlorine?
harder.prompt_hi: Lab mein room temperature par sulphur powder aur chlorine alag sealed containers mein rakhe hain. Inmein gas kaunsi hai—sulphur ya chlorine?
harder.answer: Chlorine
hints: Which material is described as a powder?
A powder consists of tiny solid pieces.
The powder is solid, so the gas is ___.
Chlorine: it is a gas at room temperature; sulphur is solid.

harder.prompt_en: A school garden has air above it, but its plants grow poorly because the soil lacks nitrogen. Why can’t the plants simply use the nitrogen gas in the air?
harder.prompt_hi: School garden ke upar hawa hai, lekin mitti mein nitrogen kam hone se plants theek se nahi badh rahe. Plants hawa ki nitrogen gas seedhe kyun nahi le sakte?
harder.answer: Plants cannot use nitrogen gas directly; they need nitrogen in a usable form from the soil.
acceptable: They need usable nitrogen compounds in the soil
Plants cannot directly absorb nitrogen gas from air
hints: Does nitrogen being in the air mean roots can use it?
Plants take up usable nitrogen compounds through their roots.
Plants need nitrogen in a usable form from the ___.
Plants cannot use nitrogen gas directly; they absorb usable nitrogen from soil.

verified.solverAnswer: Plants cannot use nitrogen gas directly; they need nitrogen in soluble compounds.
verified.note: Both note plants cannot use N2 gas directly

harder.prompt_en: A company fills sealed packets of roasted peanuts with a non-metal gas to slow the food’s spoilage. Should it use nitrogen or oxygen?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek company roasted peanuts ke sealed packets mein non-metal gas bharti hai taaki food jaldi kharab na ho. Nitrogen ya oxygen—kaunsi use kare?
harder.answer: Nitrogen
hints: Which gas is less likely to react with the peanuts?
Keeping oxygen away helps slow spoilage.
To slow spoilage, fill the packet with ___.
Nitrogen: it helps keep oxygen away from the peanuts.

openers.prompt_en: A school workshop presses an aluminium sheet into a lunchbox lid. No other material is added. Is pressing the sheet a physical or chemical change?
openers.prompt_hi: School workshop mein aluminium sheet ko dabaakar lunchbox ka dhakkan banaya jaata hai. Koi aur material nahi milaya jaata. Sheet ko dabana physical change hai ya chemical change?
hints: What changed about the aluminium sheet?
Check whether a new substance formed or only its shape changed.
The aluminium remains aluminium; only its ___ changes.
Physical change: the aluminium has a new shape, not a new substance.

openers.prompt_en: An iron railing at school develops a reddish-brown coating after months of rain. The coating has different properties from iron. Is this a physical or chemical change?
openers.prompt_hi: School ki iron railing par kai mahine baarish ke baad laal-bhoori parat ban jaati hai. Is parat ke gun iron se alag hain. Yeh physical change hai ya chemical change?
hints: Is the coating simply iron in a different shape?
Focus on the coating’s properties compared with the original metal.
A substance with different properties has ___ formed.
Chemical change: the coating is a new substance with different properties.

harder.prompt_en: A student mixes two clear solutions during a science activity. The mixture turns cloudy and a white solid appears. What is the strongest evidence here that a chemical change occurred?
harder.prompt_hi: Science activity mein ek student do saaf solutions milata hai. Mixture dhundhla ho jaata hai aur safed solid dikhta hai. Chemical change hone ka sabse mazboot saboot kya hai?
harder.answer: Formation of a new solid
hints: Which observation suggests more than a change in appearance?
Look for something produced when the solutions meet.
The strongest evidence is the formation of a new ___.
A new solid formed; it indicates a new substance may have formed.

verified.note: Both refer to new solid/precipitate formation.

harder.prompt_en: A cricket poster is cut into strips; a sparkler burns at a celebration. Neither can easily be returned to its original form. Which one is a chemical change, and what evidence matters more than reversibility?
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket poster ko strips mein kaata jaata hai; celebration mein sparkler jalta hai. Dono ko aasani se pehle jaisa nahi bana sakte. Inmein chemical change kaunsa hai, aur reversibility se zyada zaroori saboot kya hai?
harder.answer: Burning the sparkler; new substances form
acceptable: sparkler jalna, naye padarth bante hain
hints: Does cutting create a different material?
Compare what happens to the materials, not whether you can undo it.
In ___, the material changes into new substances.
Burning the sparkler: new substances form; cutting only changes the poster’s shape.

verified.solverAnswer: The sparkler; new substances are formed with different properties.
verified.note: Both identify sparkler and new substances.

harder.prompt_en: Two students prepare drinks. One stirs sugar into room-temperature water until it disappears; the other heats chocolate until it becomes liquid. Which student caused dissolving, and is the sugar still present?
harder.prompt_hi: Do students drinks bana rahe hain. Ek room-temperature paani mein sugar ghoolta hai jab tak woh dikhna band na ho; doosra chocolate garam karke liquid banata hai. Dissolving kisne ki, aur kya sugar ab bhi maujood hai?
harder.answer: The sugar-and-water student; yes, the sugar is still present
hints: Which drink combines one substance with another?
Compare mixing into water with changing from solid to liquid.
The student mixing ___ into water caused dissolving; that substance remains.
The sugar-and-water student; yes, dissolved sugar remains in the water.

verified.solverAnswer: The student who stirred sugar caused dissolving. Yes, the sugar is still present.
verified.note: Both match sugar dissolving with sugar present.

openers.prompt_en: A gas stove burns LPG and heats a pan. Is the burning LPG undergoing a physical or chemical change?
openers.prompt_hi: Gas stove par LPG jal kar pan garam karti hai. Jalti hui LPG mein physical change hota hai ya chemical change?
hints: Does heating alone tell you what kind of change this is?
Think about whether the fuel reacts with air and forms new substances.
Fuel reacting with air to form new substances is a ___ change.
Chemical change: LPG reacts with oxygen and forms new substances.

openers.prompt_en: In a school science demonstration, a teacher covers a small flame with a glass jar. Which requirement for burning is cut off: fuel, oxygen, or ignition temperature?
openers.prompt_hi: School science demonstration mein teacher ek chhoti flame ko glass jar se dhak dete hain. Jalne ki kaunsi zaroorat cut off hoti hai: fuel, oxygen, ya ignition temperature?
hints: What can no longer enter the jar?
The cover separates the flame from fresh air.
Fresh air supplies the flame with ___.
Oxygen: the jar stops fresh air reaching the flame.

harder.prompt_en: During a supervised school demonstration, a teacher places a metal lid over a small burning tray. Why does the fire go out, even though fuel remains?
harder.prompt_hi: School mein teacher ki dekhrekh mein ek chhoti jalti tray par metal lid rakha jaata hai. Fuel bacha hone par bhi aag kyun bujh jaati hai?
harder.answer: The lid cuts off the oxygen needed for burning.
acceptable: No fresh oxygen can reach the fire
hints: Which part of the fire triangle changes when the lid is added?
The lid blocks fresh air, not the fuel.
Without a fresh supply of ___, burning stops.
The lid cuts off oxygen, so burning stops despite remaining fuel.

verified.solverAnswer: It cuts off the oxygen supply.
verified.note: Both explain oxygen cutoff.

harder.prompt_en: Two iron bicycle chains are left for weeks: one stays dry indoors, while the other gets wet in the rain. Which chain is more likely to rust, and why?
harder.prompt_hi: Do iron bicycle chains kuch hafton tak rakhi hain: ek ghar ke andar sookhi rehti hai, doosri baarish mein bheegti hai. Kis chain par rust zyada aayega, aur kyun?
harder.answer: The wet chain, because rusting needs both water and oxygen.
acceptable: The rain-wet chain; it has water and oxygen
Bheegi chain, kyunki rust ke liye paani aur oxygen chahiye
hints: What condition differs between the chains?
Air reaches both; think about what rain adds.
Rusting needs air and ___; the rainy chain has both.
The wet chain rusts more because rusting needs water and oxygen.

verified.solverAnswer: The chain that gets wet in the rain. Rusting requires moisture.
verified.note: Solver omits oxygen requirement.

harder.prompt_en: A science lab safely burns 10 g of dry leaves in a closed container. The visible ash weighs only 1 g. Is the missing mass destroyed, or has it become gases and smoke?
harder.prompt_hi: Science lab mein 10 g sookhe patte safely ek band container mein jalaye jaate hain. Dikhne wali raakh sirf 1 g hai. Kya baaki mass nasht hua, ya gases aur smoke ban gaya?
harder.answer: It has become gases and smoke.
acceptable: It was not destroyed; it changed into gases and smoke
hints: Is ash the only product of burning?
Think about products you cannot easily see or weigh separately.
Besides ash, burning produces ___ and smoke.
It became gases and smoke; burning does not destroy matter.

verified.solverAnswer: It has become gases and smoke.

openers.prompt_en: A stone step at a Jaipur fort gets hot by day and cool at night. Its surface slowly cracks, but the pieces stay beside the step. Is this weathering or erosion?
openers.prompt_hi: Jaipur ke ek fort ki patthar ki seedhi din mein garam aur raat ko thandi hoti hai. Uski satah dheere-dheere chatakti hai, par tukde wahin rehte hain. Yeh weathering hai ya erosion?
hints: Do the cracked pieces move away?
Think about whether breaking and carrying away are different processes.
Rock breaking while its pieces stay nearby is called ___.
Weathering: the rock breaks down where it is.

openers.prompt_en: After a storm, wind carries loose sand from a school playground onto the road. Is the sand being weathered or eroded?
openers.prompt_hi: Toofaan ke baad hawa school playground ki dheeli ret sadak tak le jaati hai. Kya ret ki weathering ho rahi hai ya erosion?
hints: What happens to the sand’s location?
Focus on the movement of loose material.
When wind carries material away, the process is ___.
Erosion: wind carries the loose sand away.

harder.prompt_en: Rainwater enters a crack in a Ladakh road-cut rock and freezes on winter nights. Why might the crack widen over time?
harder.prompt_hi: Ladakh mein sadak ke paas chattan ki daraar mein baarish ka paani jaata hai aur sardiyon ki raaton mein jamta hai. Samay ke saath daraar kyun chaudi ho sakti hai?
harder.answer: Water expands when it freezes, pushing the crack wider.
acceptable: freezing water expands and pushes the rock apart
barf banne par paani failta hai aur daraar badhti hai
hints: What changes when water in the crack freezes?
Think about the pressure inside the crack.
Freezing water ___, pushing against the rock.
Water expands on freezing, so it pushes the crack wider.

verified.solverAnswer: Water expands when it freezes, pushing the crack wider.

harder.prompt_en: On a beach, waves loosen sand from the shore and carry it farther along the coast. Which part is erosion: loosening the sand, carrying it away, or both?
harder.prompt_hi: Beach par lehron se kinare ki ret dheeli hoti hai aur phir woh ret tat ke aage chali jaati hai. Erosion kaunsa hissa hai: ret ka dheela hona, uska behkar door jaana, ya dono?
harder.answer: Carrying it away
hints: Which part changes where the sand is?
Distinguish loosening material from transporting it.
The relevant part is the sand being ___.
Carrying it away: erosion transports loosened material.

verified.note: Erosion is transport, not loosening.

harder.prompt_en: Two nearby slopes get the same heavy rain. One has trees; the other was cleared for a new road. Why is more soil likely to wash off the cleared slope?
harder.prompt_hi: Paas ki do dhalaanon par ek jaisi tez baarish hoti hai. Ek par ped hain; doosri ko nayi sadak ke liye saaf kiya gaya hai. Saaf dhalaan se zyada mitti kyun beh sakti hai?
harder.answer: Without tree roots holding the soil, rainwater can carry more of it away.
acceptable: tree roots hold soil in place
pedon ki jadein mitti ko baandhkar rakhti hain
without roots, soil washes away more easily
hints: What helps soil stay on the planted slope?
Consider what is beneath the trees, not just their leaves.
Without ___ holding soil, rain can wash more away.
Tree roots hold soil; without them, rain carries more soil away.

verified.solverAnswer: Tree roots bind soil; without them, water washes soil away.
verified.note: Answers match key meaning

openers.prompt_en: At a school health session, Meera asks what brings about the body changes of puberty. Is it hormones or extra homework?
openers.prompt_hi: School health session mein Meera poochti hai: puberty ke dauraan body mein badlav kiski wajah se aate hain—hormones ya extra homework?
hints: Which option can send messages inside the body?
Think of chemical messengers that regulate growth and change.
The body changes are brought about by ___.
Hormones: these chemical messengers bring about puberty changes.

openers.prompt_en: After football practice, Kabir notices he sweats more than he used to. During adolescence, which become more active: sweat glands or bones?
openers.prompt_hi: Football practice ke baad Kabir notice karta hai ki ab use pehle se zyada paseena aata hai. Adolescence mein kya zyada active hota hai—sweat glands ya bones?
hints: Which option directly produces what Kabir notices?
During adolescence, some skin glands become more active.
More sweating points to more active ___.
Sweat glands: increased activity can cause more sweating.

harder.prompt_en: A health poster says, ‘Puberty and adolescence mean exactly the same thing.’ Which is more accurate: ‘Puberty is the physical-change process within adolescence’ or ‘Puberty begins only after adolescence ends’?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek health poster kehta hai, ‘Puberty aur adolescence bilkul ek hi cheez hain.’ Kaunsi baat zyada sahi hai: ‘Puberty, adolescence ke dauraan hone wale physical changes ki process hai’ ya ‘Puberty adolescence khatam hone ke baad shuru hoti hai’?
harder.answer: Puberty is the physical-change process within adolescence
acceptable: puberty adolescence ke dauraan hoti hai
hints: Does one term describe a stage of life?
The other term focuses on bodily changes during that stage.
Puberty is a process that happens ___ adolescence.
Puberty is the physical-change process within adolescence, not after it.

verified.solverAnswer: Puberty is the physical-change process within adolescence

harder.prompt_en: A student notices an oily forehead and more pimples, though their diet has not changed. Which physical change of adolescence best explains this: more active oil glands or a growth spurt?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek student ka forehead zyada oily ho gaya hai aur pimples bhi badhe hain, lekin diet nahi badli. Adolescence ka kaunsa change ise behtar samjhata hai—oil glands ka zyada active hona ya growth spurt?
harder.answer: More active oil glands
hints: Which option affects the skin directly?
Think about what produces oil on the skin.
An oily forehead points to more active ___.
More active oil glands can make skin oily and contribute to pimples.

harder.prompt_en: At 14, Tara has started her periods, while her classmate has not. Why is this difference alone not a sign that something is wrong?
harder.prompt_hi: 14 saal ki Tara ke periods shuru ho gaye hain, par uski classmate ke nahi. Sirf is farq se yeh kyun nahi keh sakte ki kuch galat hai?
harder.answer: The timing of puberty changes differs from person to person
acceptable: periods can start at different ages
puberty ka time sabke liye alag hota hai
hints: Must classmates’ bodies follow the same timetable?
Adolescent changes do not begin at one fixed age.
This difference can be normal because timing ___ between people.
Puberty timing differs from person to person; later changes can be normal.

verified.solverAnswer: Puberty timing varies normally among individuals.
verified.note: Answers match key meaning

openers.prompt_en: Riya feels upset when her friends do not like the photo she chose for the school magazine. Which common adolescent change fits best: caring more about friends’ opinions or needing more sleep?
openers.prompt_hi: Riya school magazine ke liye apni chuni photo friends ko pasand na aane par upset hai. Adolescence ka kaunsa badlav fit hota hai: friends ki rai ki zyada parvah ya zyada neend ki zaroorat?
acceptable: friends ki rai ki zyada parvah
hints: What exactly upset Riya?
Notice whose reaction matters to her.
She is giving more importance to her ___’ reactions.
Caring more about friends’ opinions fits; their reaction upset her.

openers.prompt_en: Arjun wants to ask about changes during puberty but prefers privacy at school. Who is the better person to approach: the school counsellor or a student he barely knows?
openers.prompt_hi: Arjun puberty ke badlavon ke baare mein poochhna chahta hai, lekin school mein privacy chahta hai. Kisse baat karna behtar hoga: school counsellor se ya ek student se jise woh mushkil se jaanta hai?
hints: Who is there to help students discuss worries?
Choose someone trained to listen and respect privacy.
At school, Arjun could approach the ___ .
The school counsellor is trained to help students discuss worries privately.

harder.prompt_en: Meera wants to choose her own clothes for a school event. She also keeps checking whether her classmates approve. Name the two common adolescent changes shown here.
harder.prompt_hi: Meera school event ke liye apne kapde khud chunna chahti hai. Woh baar-baar check bhi karti hai ki classmates ko woh pasand hain ya nahi. Adolescence ke kaunse do aam badlav dikhte hain?
harder.answer: Wanting more independence and caring more about friends’ opinions
acceptable: khud faisla lena aur friends ki rai ki parvah
hints: What does Meera want to decide herself?
Now notice whose approval she checks.
The two changes are wanting more ___ and caring about ___ .
She wants more independence and cares more about friends’ opinions.

verified.solverAnswer: desire for independence, need for peer acceptance
verified.note: Answers match key meaning

harder.prompt_en: During a school trip, a student feels unsafe and cannot reach family or teachers. In India, which helpline should they call: 1098 or the train enquiry number 139?
harder.prompt_hi: School trip ke dauraan ek student ko unsafe lag raha hai aur family ya teachers se contact nahi ho paa raha. India mein kaunsi helpline call kare: 1098 ya train enquiry number 139?
hints: Is this a travel enquiry or a child-safety concern?
Choose the number meant for children needing help.
The child-help number is ___, not the travel-enquiry number.
1098 is the child helpline for a student needing safety support.

harder.prompt_en: Teammates pressure Zoya to skip sleep and practise kabaddi late every night before a match. Why is saying no and getting enough sleep healthier than agreeing?
harder.prompt_hi: Match se pehle teammates Zoya par har raat der tak kabaddi practice karne aur neend kam karne ka pressure daalte hain. Mana karke poori neend lena haan kehne se zyada healthy kyun hai?
harder.answer: Sleep supports health and performance; saying no avoids harmful peer pressure.
acceptable: poori neend sehat aur performance ke liye zaroori hai
mana karna peer pressure se bachata hai
hints: How might too little rest affect the match?
Think about recovery and making your own healthy choice.
Enough rest helps ___; refusing avoids unhealthy ___ .
Sleep supports recovery and performance; saying no resists harmful peer pressure.

verified.solverAnswer: Sleep is essential for growth and rest
verified.note: Solver misses peer pressure

openers.prompt_en: After cricket practice, Aarav eats only plain toast. To support muscle growth during adolescence, should he add a boiled egg or more plain toast?
openers.prompt_hi: Cricket practice ke baad Aarav sirf plain toast khata hai. Adolescence mein muscles ki growth ke liye use boiled egg add karna chahiye ya aur plain toast?
hints: Which option supplies more of the nutrient used to build body tissues?
Think about protein, not just energy.
For growing muscles, Aarav should add ___.
A boiled egg: its protein helps build growing muscles.

openers.prompt_en: Meher brings a chana salad to school. To help her body absorb iron from the chana, should she squeeze lemon on it or add extra salt?
openers.prompt_hi: Meher school mein chana salad laati hai. Chane ka iron body mein absorb hone mein madad ke liye woh neembu nichode ya extra namak daale?
hints: Which addition offers a nutrient that helps iron absorption?
Vitamin C helps the body take in iron from food.
To help absorb iron, Meher should add ___.
Lemon: its vitamin C helps the body absorb iron.

harder.prompt_en: A doctor says Kabir has anaemia because his diet has too little iron. Why might he feel tired even after sleeping well? Answer with what iron helps blood do.
harder.prompt_hi: Doctor kehte hain ki Kabir ko diet mein iron kam hone se anaemia hai. Achchhi neend ke baad bhi woh thaka hua kyon ho sakta hai? Batao iron blood ko kya karne mein madad karta hai.
harder.answer: Iron helps blood carry oxygen; with too little iron, less oxygen reaches the body.
hints: What does blood deliver throughout the body?
Iron is needed to make haemoglobin in blood.
With too little iron, blood carries less ___ to body cells.
Less oxygen reaches his cells: iron helps blood carry it.

harder.prompt_en: After a sweaty kabaddi match, Sana has no time for a full bath before a school event. Which is the better hygiene choice: change into clean clothes after washing, or cover the sweaty clothes with perfume?
harder.prompt_hi: Paseene wale kabaddi match ke baad school event se pehle Sana ke paas poore bath ka time nahi hai. Behtar hygiene choice kya hai: dhokar saaf kapde pehne, ya paseene wale kapdon par perfume lagaye?
harder.answer: Change into clean clothes after washing
hints: Which choice removes sweat rather than hiding its smell?
Clean skin and clothes help prevent body odour.
Sana should wash and then ___.
Wash and change into clean clothes: perfume only masks the smell.

verified.solverAnswer: change into clean clothes after washing

harder.prompt_en: Two Class 7 students have a test tomorrow. Dev skips dinner to study late and sleeps five hours. Isha eats dinner, takes a short walk, and sleeps eight hours. Whose plan better supports health and concentration?
harder.prompt_hi: Kal do Class 7 students ka test hai. Dev dinner chhodkar der tak padhta hai aur paanch ghante sota hai. Isha dinner khati hai, thoda walk karti hai aur aath ghante soti hai. Kiska plan health aur concentration ke liye behtar hai?
harder.answer: Isha's plan
hints: Which routine meets more than just study needs?
Meals, activity and enough sleep all support health.
The better plan is ___.
Isha’s plan: it includes dinner, activity and enough sleep.

openers.prompt_en: A metal lunchbox is warm after sitting in the sun. Riya places a cool metal key against it. Which way does heat pass between them: lunchbox to key or key to lunchbox?
openers.prompt_hi: Dhoop mein rakha metal lunchbox garam hai. Riya usse ek thandi metal chaabi chhuati hai. Heat kis taraf jaayegi: lunchbox se chaabi ya chaabi se lunchbox?
hints: Which object starts warmer?
Conduction transfers heat between objects touching each other.
Heat passes from the ___ to the ___.
Lunchbox to key: heat passes from the warmer metal to the cooler metal.

openers.prompt_en: For a school experiment, you need heat to travel quickly through a strip. Which should you choose: aluminium or plastic?
openers.prompt_hi: School experiment mein heat ko ek strip se jaldi guzarna hai. Kya chunoge: aluminium ya plastic?
hints: Which material lets heat pass through more easily?
Think about how metals compare with plastic as heat conductors.
Choose the strip made of ___.
Aluminium: as a metal, it conducts heat better than plastic.

harder.prompt_en: A science club needs a container that slows heat entering a cold drink. They can use a thin copper cup or a thick clay cup. Which material is the poorer conductor: copper or clay?
harder.prompt_hi: Science club ko cold drink mein heat ka aana dheema karna hai. Thin copper cup aur thick clay cup milte hain. Poor conductor kaunsa material hai: copper ya clay?
harder.answer: Clay
hints: Which material resists heat passing through it?
Compare a metal with a non-metal used for insulation.
The poorer conductor is ___.
Clay: it conducts heat less readily than copper.

harder.prompt_en: A delivery rider carries ice cream in a box lined with foam that traps air. Why does this lining help the ice cream stay frozen longer?
harder.prompt_hi: Delivery rider ice cream ko aise box mein le jaata hai jiske foam mein hawa phansi rehti hai. Yeh lining ice cream ko zyada der frozen rakhne mein kaise madad karti hai?
harder.answer: Trapped air is a poor conductor, so heat enters more slowly.
acceptable: air insulates and slows heat entering
trapped air reduces heat transfer into the box
phansi hawa heat ko andar aane se dheema karti hai
hints: What surrounds the ice cream outside the box?
Consider whether trapped air lets heat pass easily.
Trapped air slows heat moving ___ the box.
Trapped air is a poor conductor, so heat enters more slowly.

verified.solverAnswer: Trapped air is a poor conductor, reducing heat transfer.
verified.note: Answers match on insulation by trapped air.

harder.prompt_en: A steel bicycle pedal and its rubber grip have stood in the same room overnight. The steel feels colder to your bare foot. Why, if both are at room temperature?
harder.prompt_hi: Steel bicycle pedal aur uski rubber grip poori raat ek hi room mein the. Nange pair ko steel zyada thanda lagta hai. Dono room temperature par hain, phir kyun?
harder.answer: Steel conducts heat away from the foot faster than rubber.
acceptable: steel takes heat from the foot faster
metal conducts heat away faster than rubber

openers.prompt_en: A drop of ink is placed near the bottom of a beaker of water. The beaker is gently heated from below. Will the ink first move upward or downward with the water?
openers.prompt_hi: Paani ke beaker mein neeche ki taraf ink ki ek boond daali gayi. Beaker ko neeche se dheere-dheere garam kiya. Ink paani ke saath pehle upar jayegi ya neeche?
hints: Which water gets heated first?
Heating makes that part of the water lighter.
The lighter water moves ___.
Upward: heated water becomes lighter and rises.

openers.prompt_en: A steel spoon rests in hot soup. Its handle warms, and soup near the bottom rises. Which involves a moving fluid: the handle warming or the soup rising?
openers.prompt_hi: Garam soup mein steel ka chamach rakha hai. Uska handle garam hota hai aur neeche ka soup upar aata hai. Moving fluid kis mein hai: handle garam hone mein ya soup upar aane mein?
hints: Which material can flow here?
Convection needs liquid or gas to move.
The moving fluid is the ___.
The soup rising: soup moves, but the steel handle does not.

harder.prompt_en: Riya says, ‘Heat only travels upward because warm air rises.’ Why can a metal bench beside a hot tawa still become warm? Answer using heat flow and convection.
harder.prompt_hi: Riya kehti hai, ‘Heat sirf upar jaati hai kyunki garam hawa upar uthti hai.’ Garam tawa ke bagal ki metal bench phir bhi garam kyun ho sakti hai? Heat flow aur convection ka fark batao.
harder.answer: Heat can flow from hot to cold in any direction; only the warm fluid rises in convection.
acceptable: Heat moves from hot to cold in all directions; warm air rises during convection
Heat har direction mein hot se cold ja sakti hai; convection mein garam hawa upar uthti hai
hints: Is rising air the same thing as heat flow?
Separate heat’s direction from the movement of warm fluid.
Heat flows from ___ to ___; in convection, warm fluid ___.
Heat flows hot to cold in any direction; warm fluid rises in convection.

verified.solverAnswer: Heat travels by conduction through the bench, not convection.
verified.note: Solver misses convection contrast.

harder.prompt_en: At 9 pm, the land near a Goa beach has cooled faster than the sea. A kite is flying low above the shore. Will the breeze near the ground push it towards the sea or towards the land?
harder.prompt_hi: Raat 9 baje Goa ke beach par zameen, samundar se jaldi thandi ho gayi hai. Kinare ke paas ek patang neeche ud rahi hai. Zameen ke paas ki hawa use samundar ki taraf dhakelegi ya zameen ki taraf?

hints: Which surface is warmer at this time?
Air rises over the warmer surface; other air moves in below.
Near the ground, air moves from ___ towards ___.
Towards the sea: air rises over warmer water, drawing air from land.

harder.prompt_en: A school kitchen is installing an exhaust fan to remove hot air. Should it go near the ceiling or near the floor? Give the convection reason in one short phrase.
harder.prompt_hi: School kitchen mein garam hawa nikalne ke liye exhaust fan lag raha hai. Use ceiling ke paas lagana chahiye ya floor ke paas? Convection ki wajah ek chhote phrase mein batao.
harder.answer: Near the ceiling, because hot air rises.
acceptable: ceiling ke paas, kyunki garam hawa upar uthti hai
high up because warm air rises
hints: Where will the kitchen’s warm air collect?
Convection moves warmer air above cooler air.
Put the fan near the ___, where ___ collects.
Near the ceiling: rising hot air can leave through the fan.

openers.prompt_en: A satellite's sun-facing panel warms up in space, where there is almost no air. Which transfers heat to it: conduction, convection, or radiation?
openers.prompt_hi: Space mein satellite ka Sun ki taraf wala panel garam hota hai, jabki wahan lagbhag hawa nahi hai. Heat us tak conduction, convection ya radiation se pahunchti hai?
hints: What is missing in the space around the panel?
Eliminate methods that need matter between the heat source and panel.
Heat crosses the nearly empty gap by ___.
Radiation transfers heat across the nearly empty gap.

openers.prompt_en: Two identical lunchbox lids, one matte black and one shiny silver, sit in direct sunlight. Which lid absorbs more heat radiation?
openers.prompt_hi: Do ek jaise lunchbox lids, ek matte black aur ek shiny silver, seedhi dhoop mein rakhe hain. Kaunsa lid zyada heat radiation absorb karega?
hints: Does a shiny surface reflect much of the incoming radiation?
Compare reflection with absorption for the two finishes.
The lid that absorbs more is the ___ one.
The matte black lid absorbs more; shiny silver reflects more.

harder.prompt_en: A student says a spacecraft cannot be warmed by the Sun because space has almost no air to carry heat. What key idea corrects this claim?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek student kehta hai ki space mein lagbhag hawa nahi hai, isliye Sun spacecraft ko garam nahi kar sakta. Kaunsa main idea is baat ko galat sabit karta hai?
harder.answer: Radiation transfers heat through empty space without needing air
acceptable: radiation can travel through a vacuum
vikiran ko hawa ki zaroorat nahi hoti
hints: Must every way of transferring heat have air in between?
Think of a transfer method that needs no material medium.
Sunlight heats the spacecraft because heat can travel through ___ without air.
Radiation travels through empty space, so air is unnecessary.

verified.solverAnswer: Heat can transfer by radiation without a medium.
verified.note: Answers match key meaning

harder.prompt_en: Two identical metal trays, one dull black and one shiny white, start at the same temperature under a heat lamp. Which tray will warm faster from the lamp's radiation?
harder.prompt_hi: Do ek jaise metal trays, ek dull black aur ek shiny white, ek hi temperature se heat lamp ke neeche rakhe hain. Lamp ki radiation se kaunsi tray jaldi garam hogi?
harder.answer: Dull black tray
hints: Which finish is more likely to reflect incoming radiation?
A dull, dark surface absorbs more than a shiny, light one.
More absorption means the ___ tray warms faster.
The dull black tray warms faster because it absorbs more radiation.

harder.prompt_en: A school in Jaipur wants its rooftop water tank to stay cooler in May. Should it paint the tank matte black or shiny white? Give the colour and the heat-transfer reason.
harder.prompt_hi: Jaipur ka ek school chahta hai ki May mein rooftop water tank thanda rahe. Tank ko matte black ya shiny white paint karna chahiye? Colour aur heat-transfer ki wajah batao.
harder.answer: Shiny white; it reflects more of the Sun's radiation
acceptable: shiny white because it reflects sunlight
white; it absorbs less solar radiation
chamkila safed; Sun ki radiation zyada reflect karta hai
hints: Should the tank absorb or reflect more sunlight to stay cooler?
Think about how a light-coloured, shiny surface handles radiation.
Choose ___ because it ___ more incoming radiation.
Shiny white reflects more solar radiation, helping the tank stay cooler.

verified.solverAnswer: Shiny white; it reflects most radiation and absorbs less heat.
verified.note: Answers match key meaning

openers.prompt_en: After rain, water vapour rises from a school garden’s leaves and later helps form clouds. Which process releases water vapour from the leaves: evaporation or transpiration?
openers.prompt_hi: Baarish ke baad school garden ki pattiyon se water vapour upar jaata hai aur baad mein clouds banne mein madad karta hai. Pattiyon se vapour nikalne ka process evaporation hai ya transpiration?
hints: Where is the vapour coming from?
Plants release water vapour through their leaves.
The process linked specifically to plant leaves is ___.
Transpiration: plants release water vapour through their leaves.

openers.prompt_en: Rain falls on an unpaved school sports field. Some water moves down through the soil towards groundwater. What is this downward movement into the ground called?
openers.prompt_hi: Baarish ka paani school ke kachche sports field par girta hai. Kuch paani mitti se neeche groundwater ki taraf jaata hai. Zameen ke andar jaane wale is process ko kya kehte hain?
hints: Does this water flow over the field or enter the soil?
Think of the term for water entering spaces in soil.
Rainwater entering the ground is called ___.
Infiltration: rainwater seeps into the ground.

harder.prompt_en: At a Mumbai cricket ground, wet grass dries in the Sun. Later, clouds form and rain falls. Name the two water-cycle processes that change water vapour into clouds and then bring water back to the ground, in order.
harder.prompt_hi: Mumbai ke cricket ground mein dhoop se geeli ghaas sookhti hai. Baad mein clouds bante hain aur baarish hoti hai. Water vapour se clouds banne aur phir paani zameen par lautne ke do processes kram mein batao.
harder.answer: Condensation, then precipitation
hints: What happens to vapour before rain can fall?
First, cooling changes vapour into droplets; then droplets fall.
Vapour to cloud: ___; cloud to ground: ___.
Condensation, then precipitation: droplets form before they fall.

verified.note: Answers match key meaning

harder.prompt_en: After a dry summer, a Jaipur well needs a longer rope to reach water. Has the water table risen or fallen? Why?
harder.prompt_hi: Sookhi garmi ke baad Jaipur ke ek kuen mein paani tak pahunchne ke liye lambi rassi chahiye. Water table upar aaya hai ya neeche gaya hai? Kyun?
harder.answer: Fallen; the groundwater surface is deeper below the ground.
acceptable: neeche gaya kyunki paani ab zyada gehra hai
hints: What does needing more rope tell you about the water’s depth?
The water table marks the upper level of groundwater.
The water table has ___ because the water is deeper.
Fallen: the groundwater surface is now farther below the ground.
